# The expectations tests/production-release-qualification.sh required on
# 2026-09-11, when 66 of its assertions were bare commands under `set -e`:
# a failure stopped the harness with status 1 and printed nothing at all.
#
# Converting those assertions to the forms in tests/support/expected-text.sh
# rewrites the statement around each expectation. This file is the
# expectations themselves, one per line, taken from the quoted literals those
# 66 assertions searched for. The conversion has to keep every one of them, so
# that a harness which says what it wanted still refuses every input it
# refuses today.
#
# Held by tests/harness-rule-coverage.sh. Lines beginning with `#` are
# commentary; every other line is text that must still stand in the harness.
